value.title: Cross-model review — plan 009 embed split
value.note: VERDICT: REQUEST_CHANGES — one HIGH material finding (represented as MAJOR in the builder/review schema). Review target was the frozen detached SHA 3387d7612816d87dec9b95bce2ca29c54dbfa02a at /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/fs3-embed-split-review. The positive targeted pass was fresh: fs3-store pg_migrations + pg_store_flows 25/25; fs3-daemon embed_batch + boot_recovery + oversize + embed_split 15/15; pure chunk_plan 5/5. AC judgment at that SHA: ac-0001 TRUE (exact key/default/grandfather migration and lossless sequential chunks); ac-0002 TRUE (live tail retrieval plus a seeded prefix-only control); ac-0003 TRUE (one best row and whale crowd-out legs, both mutation-sensitive); ac-0004 TRUE (mint and assembly predicates are independent and separately mutation-sensitive); ac-0005 TRUE (boot recovery is wired retire-before-requeue and reversing it fails both tests with poison state pending/non-terminal); ac-0006 TRUE for the exercised isolated HTTP router/disposable-database path, with the explicit boundary that binary configuration discovery was outside that fixture; ac-0007 TRUE only for the PR-side evidence reported by the PM (PR #87 CI green in 4m21s, conventional commits, PR open), while its post-merge krill observation remains o-prime-owned. Two reviewer-local `harness checks` attempts did not produce a product verdict: each was killed by the harness command's 600-second inner timeout during cold compilation/test-db-check; this is named as an evidence boundary, not reported as a code failure. Frozen seams held except F-001: S1 exact four-column key and atomic single transaction; S2 pure UTF-8-safe chunk plan with common-path chunk 0; S3 two layers; S4 store CTE collapse with daemon fuse untouched; heal/mint both use trim().is_empty(); chunk_no is i16 end-to-end; chunks remain inputs within one job. The pre-existing raw+smart duplicate-hit defect is incidentally closed by DISTINCT ON(element_id).

value.finding: HIGH — post-plan chunk expansion bypasses the request token budget. runner::drain_embed calls batch::plan first; split_to_budget costs each ORIGINAL text and deliberately lets a single over-budget item ride alone. Only afterwards embed_items expands every item into overlapping chunks, accumulates every chunk in one texts vector, and makes one embedder.embed call. A request accepted at exactly TOKEN_BUDGET already grows from 200000 to 205400 estimated tokens; a larger single source grows without bound and can exceed the provider's aggregate request ceiling, fail every retry, and remain permanently unembedded. This violates the frozen seam that chunks are inputs to the same token-budget planner and recreates the original unsearchable-content defect one size class up. Smallest safe fix: sub-batch prepared chunks against the existing TOKEN_BUDGET, collect all returned vectors, and retain one final put_embeddings transaction so multi-chunk source atomicity survives; add a test proving multiple provider calls, each under budget, with every chunk present exactly once. The PM independently reproduced and accepted this finding.
value.receipt: Disposable scratch probe at the same SHA: cargo test -p fs3-daemon enrich::tests::chunk_expansion_must_preserve_the_planners_request_budget -- --exact -> FAILED 0 passed/1 failed: post-plan chunk expansion grew a planner-approved request from 200000 to 205400 tokens. PM independently traced the same single-call path and confirmed HIGH.

value.finding: Boot recovery ordering is genuinely defended: swapping requeue_failed before retire_empty_embed_jobs makes both boot recovery tests fail and revives poison as pending/non-terminal.

value.finding: Both ac-0003 legs defend the store-level element collapse. Removing DISTINCT ON(element_id) returns three rows for one element and allows whale chunks to consume the limited page.
value.receipt: Removed both DISTINCT ON(element_id) clauses: cargo test -p fs3-store --test pg_store_flows -> FAILED exactly 2 of 17: best-score leg left=3 rows/right=1; crowd-out addresses were whale f0 three times and omitted f1. Source restored; scratch git status empty.

value.finding: The ac-0002 negative leg is a real seeded prefix-only control, not an assertion claiming chunking is disabled: the matching element has prefix chunk 0 plus matching tail chunk 1, while the control has only the same nonmatching prefix chunk 0.
value.receipt: Fresh pg_store_flows pass included a_tail_chunk_is_retrievable_while_a_prefix_only_control_is_not; source inspection at lines 958-980 proves the control has no tail chunk. Fresh isolated router fixture also retrieved conv:<guid>#t1 from a tail-only anchor.

value.rationale: REQUEST_CHANGES. The defect breaks the frozen aggregate-budget seam and leaves legal very-large inputs on a permanent provider-rejection path. PM independently confirmed and dispatched the fix to u2.
